counterfactual_missing_items: no travel history to leishmaniasis‐endemic areas
no rK39 serology, splenic aspirate, or culture for Leishmania documented
no peripheral blood smear or malaria RDT result documented
decisive_items: intermittent fever with chills and profuse sweating
response.rationale: R5 unifies the strongest raw span cluster: intermittent fever with sweating, massive splenomegaly, anemia, and leukopenia. R3 is the closest differential because it also uses fever/chills and splenomegaly, but it lacks the cytopenic composite and the integrative coincidence of the VL pattern. R1 explains only organomegaly; R2 has almost no raw support; R4 has no raw support. C1 is a correlated restatement of R5 and adds no independent raw diagnostic axis.

rejected.why: Only splenomegaly is raw-supported; there is no autoimmune phenotype, lymphadenopathy, family history, or genetic signature to support ALPS.
No raw support span is supplied for TB; fever and elevated ESR are nonspecific, and the normal chest radiograph plus absent lymphadenopathy do not support it.
Raw support covers only splenomegaly and mild hepatomegaly; the febrile and cytopenic picture is not integrated, and no lymphadenopathy is an evident mismatch.
It repeats R5 as an appended completion with massive splenomegaly already present in R5's raw-support spans; it is a correlated restatement rather than an independent evidence source.
